## Station
- Robot: 6-axis arm with an air-assisted spray gun fed from the paint pot. It sprays raster passes: horizontal

- Panel rack: the cabinet doors of job J-2214 (2214-1, 2214-2), 500 x 700 mm, degreased and ready. Coordinates on a panel are in

- Paint: one pot of polyurethane topcoat PU-9 (RAL 5015 blue); `paint status` shows the level and the lot certificate.
- Station logbook: ~/LOGBOOK.md.

## Tools (on PATH; add --json for machine-readable output)
  robot status                       gun, pot and robot time
